import ast, builtins, hashlib, json, os, sys
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
ROOT = Path.cwd().resolve()
BASE = ROOT / "results/letter/x_ctmc_c"
SCRIPT = ROOT / "experiments/letter/x_rescore_independent.py"
DESTINATION = ROOT / "results/letter/x_rescore"
ALLOWED_OUTPUTS = {str(DESTINATION / n) for n in ("rescore_x1c.json", "RESCORE_X1C.md")}
write_paths, blocked_imports = [], []
real_import = builtins.__import__
forbidden_modules = {"x_ctmc", "x_ctmc_c", "x_ctmc_card", "x_geant", "x_geant_card"}
def import_guard(name, *args, **kwargs):
    if forbidden_modules.intersection(name.split(".")):
        blocked_imports.append(name)
        raise RuntimeError("Forbidden project/scorer import: " + name)
    return real_import(name, *args, **kwargs)
builtins.__import__ = import_guard
def write_guard(event, args):
    if event == "open" and isinstance(args[2], int) and args[2] & (os.O_WRONLY | os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC | os.O_APPEND):
        name = str(Path(args[0]).resolve()) if isinstance(args[0], (str, bytes, os.PathLike)) else str(args[0])
        if name not in ALLOWED_OUTPUTS:
            raise RuntimeError("Write outside brief output: " + name)
        write_paths.append(name)
sys.addaudithook(write_guard)
source_bytes = SCRIPT.read_bytes()
source = source_bytes.decode()
script_imports = [ast.unparse(n) for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(source)) if isinstance(n, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom))]
assert all(not forbidden_modules.intersection(s.replace(".", " ").split()) for s in script_imports)
assert source.count('"results/letter/x_ctmc"') == 2
adapted = source.replace('"results/letter/x_ctmc"', '"results/letter/x_ctmc_c"').replace("CODEX_RESCORE_BRIEF.md", "CODEX_RESCORE_X1C_BRIEF.md")
ns = {"__file__": str(SCRIPT), "__name__": "independent_x1c_saved_data"}
exec(compile(adapted, str(SCRIPT), "exec"), ns)
controls = ns["self_tests"]()
inputs, comparisons = ns["Inputs"](), ns["Comparisons"]()
brief = inputs.read(ns["BRIEF"])
committed_brief = ns["git"](ns["BRIEF"].parents[2], "show", "f63d9fb:briefs/strengthen/CODEX_RESCORE_X1C_BRIEF.md")
comparisons.add("integrity.brief.f63d9fb", hashlib.sha256(brief).hexdigest(), hashlib.sha256(committed_brief).hexdigest())
assert brief == committed_brief
lock = inputs.json(BASE / "lock.json")
card_lock = inputs.json(BASE / "lock_card.json")
targets = [(str(ROOT / p), digest, "lock") for p, digest in lock["sha256"].items()]
targets += [(str(path), card_lock["sha256"][key], "lock_card") for key, path in (
    ("card", BASE / "CARD_X_CTMC.md"), ("scorer", ROOT / "experiments/letter/x_ctmc_card.py"), ("lock", BASE / "lock.json"))]
root_head = inputs.repos[ROOT]["head"]
entries = ns["git"](ROOT, "ls-tree", "-rz", root_head, "--", *[str(Path(p).relative_to(ROOT)) for p, _, _ in targets]).split(b"\0")
blobs = {}
for entry in entries:
    if entry:
        meta, path = entry.split(b"\t", 1)
        blobs[path.decode()] = meta.split()[2].decode()
locked_sources = []
for path, expected, origin in targets:
    data = Path(path).read_bytes()
    digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    relative = str(Path(path).relative_to(ROOT))
    blob = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data).hexdigest()
    comparisons.add("integrity." + origin + ".sha256." + relative, digest, expected)
    comparisons.add("integrity." + origin + ".committed." + relative, blob, blobs.get(relative))
    if digest != expected or blob != blobs.get(relative):
        raise ValueError("Locked input hash/Git mismatch: " + path)
    locked_sources.append(dict(path=path, sha256=digest, expected_sha256=expected, git_blob=blob, git_head=root_head, origin=origin, status="MATCH"))
computed = ns["ctmc_rescore"](inputs, comparisons)
predictions = json.loads((BASE / "predictions.json").read_bytes())
planned = [r for r in predictions["records"] if r["status"] == "PLANNED"]
estimator_lengths = {side: sorted({round(r["estimator"]["telemetry"][side]["W"] / r["T_int"], 9) for r in planned}) for side in ("A", "B")}
history_lengths = sorted({round(v["W"] / r["T_int"], 9) for r in planned for age in r["histories"].values() for v in age.values()})
assert estimator_lengths["A"] == estimator_lengths["B"] == [1000.0]
assert history_lengths == [100.0]
legacy_record_T_int = computed["ledger"]["record_T_int"]
assert legacy_record_T_int == 100
computed["history_record_T_int"] = legacy_record_T_int
computed["estimator_record_T_int"] = 1000
computed["ledger"]["record_T_int"] = int(estimator_lengths["A"][0])
ledger_document = inputs.json(ns["LEDGER"])
reported_ledger = ledger_document["rows"]["X_CTMC_C"]
comparisons.tree("ledger.X_CTMC_C", computed["ledger"], reported_ledger["recomputed"])
summary = dict(Counter(f["status"] for f in comparisons.fields))
print(json.dumps(dict(overall="MISMATCH" if summary.get("MISMATCH", 0) else "MATCH", comparison_summary=summary, controls=len(controls),
    raw_receipt_files=computed["raw_regimes"], locked_hash_checks=len(locked_sources),
    T1=computed["card"]["T1"], T3=computed["card"]["T3"],
    verdicts={k:computed["card"][k]["verdict"] for k in ("T1","T2","T3","T4","T5","T6","T6b")}), ensure_ascii=False))
